moments.title: Glasgow Commonwealth Games Wrap
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow concluded on August 2nd after 11 days of competition, with a spectacular closing ceremony at the OVO Hydro.

angles.name: Game On, Glasgow!
angles.copy: What a fortnight! Glasgow delivered an incredible Commonwealth Games. Which moments will live longest in your memory? #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Scottish Pride
angles.copy: Glasgow, you smashed it! The 2026 Commonwealth Games were a triumph for Scotland. What was your highlight from the games?

moments.title: Scottish Premiership Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Scottish Premiership season is officially underway, having kicked off on July 31st, with matches continuing this week and next.

angles.name: Football Fever North
angles.copy: The Scottish Premiership is back with a bang! Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Catching up on the early Scottish Premiership action? Kilmarnock take on Celtic this Sunday (Aug 9th) at 1:30pm, with Rangers vs Hibernian at 4pm.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield 2026, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will be held on August 16th at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Big football coming to the capital! The Community Shield clash between Arsenal and Man City is at Principality Stadium on August 16th. Are you going?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Man City
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs! Arsenal face Manchester City in the Community Shield on August 16th. Who's your money on?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to kick off on Friday, August 21st, a week later than usual due to the expanded FIFA World Cup 2026.

angles.name: Countdown to Kick-off
angles.copy: Not long now! The Premier League returns on August 21st. Who are you most excited to see in action this season?

angles.name: New Season, New Hopes
angles.copy: The 2026/27 Premier League season is almost here! Will your team make a strong start? Get ready for August 21st!

moments.title: Happy 65th to The Edge
moments.blurb: U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge (David Howell Evans), celebrates his 65th birthday on August 8th.

angles.name: Guitar Legend Turns 65
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge, this Saturday! What's your favourite U2 riff he's given us?

angles.name: U2's Sound Architect
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to The Edge on August 8th! His distinctive sound has defined U2 for decades. Which song showcases him best?

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson Turns 68

angles.name: Iron Maiden Legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the one and only Bruce Dickinson this Friday! Beyond the music, he's also a pilot and fencer!

angles.name: Ginger Spice at 54
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell, this Thursday! Still got it!

angles.name: Mendes at 28
angles.copy: Wishing Shawn Mendes a very happy 28th birthday on August 8th! From Vine star to global superstar, what an journey!

angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to Steve Martin next Friday! A master of comedy, acting, and a brilliant banjo player!

moments.title: BBC Proms Continues

angles.copy: From traditional to genre-spanning performances, the BBC Proms continues its run until September 12th. A true London summer institution!
